topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Wave Superposition
lecture_lines: Light waves can superimpose and interfere.
Constructive interference happens when peaks align.
Destructive interference occurs when peaks meet troughs.

sections.title: Diffraction: Bending Around Barriers
lecture_lines: Diffraction is waves bending around barriers.
Light spreads out passing through small apertures.
animations: Show two wave sources at #FFFFFF (white) creating concentric ripples, originating from two [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/aperture.svg] icons.

Overlap the ripples to highlight interference zones at #FFD700 (gold), passing through a central [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barrier.svg] to demonstrate diffraction effects.
Color constructive areas #00FF00 (bright green) and destructive at #FF0000 (red) around the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barrier.svg].

sections.title: The Holographic Recording Process
lecture_lines: Holography uses a two-beam interference technique.
A laser splits into object and reference beams.
They combine on a sensitive plate.
The plate captures the interference pattern.
This is the hologram's coded data.
animations: Display a laser [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg] source at #FF0000 (red) splitting into two beams.
Direct one beam toward an object [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/object.svg] and one directly to the screen.
Show the two beams intersecting on a photographic plate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg] at #0000FF (blue).
Overlay a grid pattern on the plate showing interference fringes in #FFFF00 (yellow).
Fade out the light paths, leaving only the fringe pattern on the plate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg].

sections.title: Reconstruction: Decoding the Wavefront
lecture_lines: Illuminate the hologram with the reference beam.
The light diffracts through the recorded pattern.
animations: Show the laser reference beam [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg] hitting the fringe pattern at #FFFF00 (yellow).
Animate light rays bending as they pass through the pattern (diffraction).
Project a 3D translucent light-field of an object appearing behind the hologram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hologram.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Holography is essentially frozen diffraction interference.
Security holograms demonstrate this complex principle.
animations: Re-display the original fringe pattern at #FFFF00 (yellow).
Transition the static pattern into a 3D view of an object rotating.
Overlay a security [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/creditcard.svg] icon showing a dynamic hologram color shift from cyan #00FFFF to magenta #FF00FF.
